# GNK ASG — Web and Mobile Test Matrix

Status: locked preparation. This file is not part of the public portal build.

## Purpose

Use this matrix before enabling any new module publicly.

## Desktop checks

- Homepage loads.
- Main navigation opens all key pages.
- Language switch does not break route context.
- Latest content cards have working links.
- Share buttons copy or open correct canonical URL.
- Contact link is visible and correct.
- No hidden preparation files are linked.
- No empty modules are visible.

## Mobile checks

- Header does not overlap content.
- Mobile menu opens and closes correctly.
- Bottom action bar does not hide important content.
- Floating action menu does not cover text.
- Cards stack correctly.
- Images scale correctly.
- Buttons are large enough for touch.
- Contact is reachable in one or two taps.
- Latest insight is readable.
- Desk entry is clear.

## Content checks

- Main story remains corporate.
- Personal layer is discreet and accurate.
- Text is readable on phone.
- No paragraph is too long.
- CTA is clear.
- Sources or context are visible where needed.

## Performance checks

- No heavy script blocks first render.
- Images are compressed.
- Non-critical scripts are deferred.
- Fonts do not block the page unnecessarily.
- Large cards lazy-load when possible.

## Visual checks

- Corporate blue/gold identity is consistent.
- No visual looks misleading.
- Preview image appears correctly.
- Article card image crops acceptably on mobile.
- Video thumbnail is legible.

## Fail rule

If mobile usability fails, do not activate the public module.
